blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: Probulin® Daily Care is a balanced once daily Probiotic + Prebiotic that:
Probulin® goes the extra mile to ensure your probiotics are alive when you buy them, alive when you take them, and alive when they reach your gut.

Our scientifically-validated MAKTrek® 3-D system includes a unique seaweed barrier to protect against stomach acid, prebiotic fiber for food, and electrolytes for hydration. Probulin probiotics arrive in the gut healthy and ready to work.

Probulin's Daily Care Probiotic features 12 probiotic strains to provide broad-spectrum support for digestive health and immune function. Taking a probiotic is an important part of your daily wellness routine.
Formulated by: Jason Mitchell, N.D ., Founder & CEO
§Board-certified Naturopathic Doctor specializing in research & development
‡Refrigeration is not required but may help to extend shelf life. Store in a cool dry place at 72°F (22°C) or below.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Adults take one (1) capsule daily with or without food. For best results, take at bedtime. As a reminder, discuss the supplements and medications that you take with your health care providers.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Complex marine polysaccharides [brown seaweed (lessonia nigrescens)], vegetable cellulose (capsule shell), cellulose, non-gmo rice extract, tricalcium phosphate, sodium chloride, potassium chloride.
No: GMOs, wheat, gluten, dairy, eggs, magnesium stearate, soy, artificial flavors, artificial colors, artificial sweeteners or shellfish.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement.
Do not accept if seal is broken. Keep out of the reach of children.
